batting.dismissal: c B Lee b SJ Srivastava

batting.dismissal: c B Lee b IK Pathan

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh

batting.name: KC Sangakkara

balls.text: Tiwary you beauty! Irfan has tried everything, and Tiwary's had a shot for all his variations in the last over. He pulled back the length this time, Tiwary was expecting it, stayed back and bunted it over mid off's head this time for four more. Great finish, KKR have got to 183!
whoop! Irfan has been taken apart in his last over, towering six from Tiwary! Full outside off, he was down the track again and had the momentum going into the drive, over long off for six more!
another boundary, this time through the offside! It is full outside off this time, Tiwary stays back and drills it through the covers.
great hit! At long last, the law of averages have caught up and Tiwary times the pull shot, he timed it really well, and got it over midwicket

Lee is at it again! Short and wide outside off, Mathews is down the track and times it well, almost over cover, but Brett Lee jumps high, that's a jump that would have done Bruce Lee proud, to pluck it!
full and very wide outside off, he reaches it and guides it down behind square for one

lucky boundary, seemed the only way they could get four off Lee this over. Short of a length outside off, Mathews tried to open the face and get it through the offside, got a thick outside edge wide of Sangakkara, and it ran away at Brett Lee pace for a four through third man
another short ball, at 140.8 kph and Tiwary struggles to get hold for it again. The pull dribbles down between midwicket and long on for one
bangs it in short, and Tiwary can't time the pull shot, straight to midwicket
attempted yorker on leg stump, at 142 kph, he can only drive it down to long on where Chawla cleanly stops this time
lovely slower ball, Mathews was beaten all ends up and almost fell down in trying to re-adjust and get it to long on, Chawla misfielded to concede two.
short of a length, Tiwary is hopping around and cannot make good contact, Runs off the bottom edge to Sanga, who fumbles, they steal a run
finally times one. Mathews is down the track and tees off towards long off, where Bopara makes a mess of it. Through for four.
pitched up on leg, dances down the track and drives it down to long off
very wide down the legside, and the batsman cannot connect despite trying to reverse-sweep. Called a wide and Sanga is indignant!
full on off stump, legspinner again, opens the face and dabs it to short third man
comes down the track and takes the high fulltoss, driven down to long on for a couple.
again, leggie on leg stump, at 88 kph, dabbed away off the backfoot to midwicket
drifts on to the pads, and swept away to short third man
itched up and driven straight back, Irfan could not get a finger on it, else it would have been curtains for the non-striker, as it hit the stumps.
and again. Irfan has lost the plot at the end of the over and Sanga will be quite angry. The over-rate is going nowhere.
slips down the leg for a wide.
slow off cutter, short of a length, Mathews picked it and guided it through the covers for a couple
fulltoss wide outside off, Tiwary guides it off the front footto deep point to reach his fifty. He has opened up well after an indifferent start
workman-like pull from Tiwary, it was not very pacy from Irfan and the batsman had to make all the pace as he pulled it away, to find the gap between long on and midwicket
short of a length, played away off the backfoot to cover. Angelo is off the mark
full and wide outside off, driven nicely but straight to long off

Chawla has done in Hussey! Good piece of bowling, again drawing him out with an enticing length, but it pitched just short of the batsman's reach, and spun through to wreck the stumps. Big wicket, a lot was expected from Hussey
short and wide outside off, stays back and cuts it, for no runs
mock-charges him, brings out a short ball from Piyush, stays back and pulls it wide of mid on
on to leg stump here, keeps it short of a length, he's down the track again, but only gets a single to midwicket
full on off stump, jumps out and drives down to long off.
pitched up on leg stump, gets forward and drives down to long on
super finish to the over, full yorker on off stump and Tiwary can't dig it out for runs. Played back to Irfan
bouncer first up, Hussey is hurried into the pull shot but gets it down to midwicket
slower ball, pitched up outside Tiwary's off stump, he drives it down to long on to give David Hussey strike

in the end, a really tame end. Short of a length from Irfan, and Ganguly was desperate for a boundary after those two dot balls, looked to go straight and high, but the length was not there for the loft. It ballooned up meekly for a simple catch for long off, running in
and good fielding this time off his own bowling. Good line, cramps Ganguly again, and he tries to drive down the ground, Pathan reacts well to stop it
nice ball, follows Ganguly as he moves away outside leg stump and gives him no room.
drifts on to his pads, Tiwary works it away towards square leg and runs hard for a double
shortens the length, similar shot attempted, but he inside-edges this one, luckily misses the stumps and four more down to fine leg
Tiwary has played a couple of really pretty shots today, even Ganguly loved that! Yorker on middle stump, Tiwary kept his wits about him, and opened the face, it ran down to third man.,
fifty to Ganguly. Worked away off the pads to midwicket. It's been a struggle, but he's looking better and better.
driven straight to Lee at cover, Tiwary was well down, but Lee missed the direct hit.
slow short and wide, Ganguly hits it hard down the ground, but the timing is not good again. This time they run through for two
full toss outside off, Ganguly stays back and looks to smash it through the offside, but the timing is awry. Only one, they should have pushed for two
short and wide, slower ball outside off, Tiwary got under it and played it in the air down to third man
good shot! Tiwary's gaining in confidence, low fulltoss on leg stump, he middled the drive well and got it between midwicket and long on for four
slow bouncer, at 109.6 kph, Ganguly picks it and pulls it to long on
slower ball, 105.6 kph outside off, Tiwary stays back and guides it to third man
length ball on off stump, a bit of a loosener from Lee, Tiwary can't connect too well with the hoick over midwicket
swing and a miss, goes between Ganguly, who has moved well outside leg and the leg stump, through to Sanga.
straighter this time, drilled down to long off.. Slight fumble from Chawla.
shot of the day until now! Yorker-length ball, but it was wide of off stump, and took some hitting. He stayed back and drove it nicely through the covers, beating the sweeper who was running across
down the track and looks to deposit that over the midwicket boundary, but cannot get under it. Drags it down along the carpet to deep midwicket
short and wide and called wide
legspinning slower ball, Tiwary picked it and tried to hoick it over square leg, but could not find the gap
short of a length, angling in from off at not much pace. Tiwary rocks back and pulls it away well through midwicket
and another one! Chawla dropped it short, Dada was waiting for it. Stayed back and punched it through the covers for four more.
vintage Ganguly! Pitched up outside off stump, Ganguly got forward and played that lovely loft over long on. Seen it so many times in the last many years, always brings joy to the beholders' eyes!
sees him coming, shortens the length and fires it in at 90 kph. Tiwary can't get away the attempted pull for too many
pitched up again, Ganguly dances down the track but can't get under it. Drives it down to long on
down the track, gets to the length of the ball and works it away wide of mid on
pitched up on a length, Ganguly gets forward, tips to the off side and runs
short outside off, cut away behind point for a couple.
that's nicely lapped away. Short of a length, Tiwary got down and under it and lapped it over his shoulder very fine.
looks to break free but no timing in the loft over mid on
length ball on off, Dada gets forward, misses, but takes his back foot up for a moment, it is back down before Sanga whips away the bails.
slow, short and wide outside off, Tiwary hits it away, the ball goes equally slowly to deep cover
short of a length, just outside off stump, cut away for one.
short of a length, pushes Dada back even as he tries to press forward. He plays it down to mid off and they are off for one.
slower ball from around the stumps, angling into Tiwary, who works it away with the wrists wide of mid on
bouncer attempted, but banged in very short, it rose well above Tiwary's head for another wide
slower ball this time, Ganguly works it away to the legside and scampers across, if you can use that verb while talking about him.
and Ganguly has got away a crucial four in typical fashion. Pitched up on middle and leg, he picked the length early, rocked back and smashed it over mid on, almost for a six.
short of a length slower ball outside off, Tiwary stays back and guides it in front of point. Only one.
short again, but Tiwary can't find the gap with his pull.
very short and very wide of Tiwary's off stump
Ganguly tries to play McDilScoop, but it does not come out right.
short again, but this time Tiwary gets hold of the pull after coming down the track, but can't find the legside boundary
good short ball, saw Tiwary jumping down the track, and got it past his shoulders. Tiwary ended in no position to handle it.
short of a length outside off, tries to tap it but can't get it away
again outside off, can't get it away.
full outside off stump, gets forward and looks to drive but can't get past point
pitched up on middle and leg, Tiwary jumps out and yorks himself, manages to squeeze it away to midwicket. Good start from Chawla
pitched further up, turns into Dada who gets forward and taps it to cover-point
googly to Ganguly, misses the attempted cut
outside the right-hander's off stump, Tiwary rocks back and works it through the covers
straighter one, short of a length, Ganguly stays back and cuts it away through the covers
legspinner turning away after pitching on middle and off, worked away off the back foot towards wide mid on
length ball, angling across Ganguly who lets it go. Kolkata have slowed down after that frenetic first over and Ganguly needs to counter-punch.
angles into Tiwary's pads again, and he works it away for another single
pitched up outside off, Ganguly gets well forward and drives to deep extra cover
bowled him! But it makes no difference. Ganguly picked his shot early and looked to deposit the length ball over midwicket, but made no contact.
freehit coming up, the field can change since Dada's taken strike with that single. Drifted on to his pads and turned away behind square leg.
on a length outside the off stump, Tiwary looks to tip and run to get off the mark, but it goes straight to point.
short of a length, angling across Ganguly, who stays back and taps it through the covers for a single

it was always on the cards. He is a little susceptible to the short balls and struggles to pick the length to play the pull shot. This one was not short enough for it, he played the pull all the same, and it popped up straight to mid on.
short of a length, cutting back into the right hander, who is in a bit of discomfort trying to play it away. He sure prefers it when its pitched up.
interesting shot to the ball, short and wide outside off. Ganguly rises and plays a top-spin defensive tap to keep it down.
slow slower ball, at 96.9 kph, Ganguly picked it, waited on his back-lift and timed it nicely through the covers off the backfoot.
good short ball, if it had been aimed at Gayle who is much taller than Dada. To Dada it is called wide.
in the offside, there is God and then there is Ganguly, but at deep point, there is Irfan Pathan. He puts in a good tive to stop a sweetly timed backfoot square drive from fetching four.
aggressive intent from Dada and a touch of luck. Moves away to the leg side and looks to loft him over mid on. Gets a thickish inside edge that beats short fine leg and runs away
hope this guy has a driving license because he sure loves to drive. Pitched up by Lee marginally, and Mandeep was onto it in a flash. Lovely cover drive along the ground to the boundary boards.
he's sure put a doubt in his mind with the short ball, this was again short, Mandeep was hurried into the pull, and gets it straight to mid on
pitched up this time, he drives well off front foot, but straight to point

the bouncers are working, and Mandeep is lucky he survived that one. Good bouncer again, outside off and at Lee's pace, Mandeep was really late on the pull, top edges it and it pops up near the non-striker's end to the offside of the pitch, just away from Lee's despairing dive
over-pitched on middle and leg, Ganguly punches down the track nicely, Yuvraj gets across from mid off and stops it.
pitched up, angling away from Ganguly at 137.7 kph, he gets forward and drives straight to cover. Well-timed for no runs.
great over and well finished. Angled across the right hander, from over the wickets, Mandeep gets forward and shoulders arms.

Bisla you beauty! Short of a length, good bouncer, caught Gayle by surprise, he did well to pull it away all the same, high behind square on the leg side, but someone forgot to tell Bisla that his job was to man midwicket! He ran across, covered good distance, put in the dive and picked it up with two hands, a couple of metres in front of the ropes. That's a great catch, it was swerving away from him all the time!
good ball, short of a length at 130 kph on and around off stump. Gayle regards it with respect and pats back to the bowler.
loses the plot, short and wide down the legside, Sanga has to run a few paces to his right to collect it
fuller outside off, Gayle gets forward and defends to the offside. Three dots to start the over again, the last one did not end well for Punjab.
that's more like it. Similar ball, Gayle decides to make up for his circumspection off the previous ball and looks to knock the stuffing out of this one. Good for the ball, he did not connect.
short of a length outside Gayle's off stump, he shoulders arms. Rare sight from Gayle, in any format!
better line, curving away off a length from off stump, Ganguly gets forward and plays it away towards the offside cordon for no run. Kolkata have a good start here.
and that timing is returning! Length ball on leg stump, Ganguly again moves towards the leg side, and punches it well straight down the ground.
backs away to the legside, makes enough room to loft the length ball just away from mid off and it is Yuvraj once again, who chases it all the way, but can't stop the boundary. Dada is off the mark
short of a length, outside off. Ganguly stays back and tries to work it away through the offside, cannot pierce cover. Three dots on the trot
drifts on to Dada's pads, at 124 kph, on a length. He can't get it away
slow and steady from Irfan, compared to Lee, nice line and length, shapes away from Ganguly's middle towards off stump. Defended
top shot! Pacy again, but pitched up this time and Gayle's getting used to Lee's pace. Picks it up and sends it over midwicket for four. Expensive comeback from Lee this.
great ball, shoddy wicket-keeping. Fullish yorker on Gayle's pads and it looked like he got something on it as it missed leg stump and ran away, and Sanga could not stop it. Four more
on to Gayle's pads, he gets it away between mid on and midwicket. Yuvraj huffs and puffs behind it. No ball, so Free-hit coming up!
144.8 kph, beats Gayle comprehensively for pace, with that attempted yorker that tailed in late. Gayle somehow managed to get bat on it and it runs to third man off the outside edge
pitched up and outside off stump, Gayle gets forward and drives nicely through cover-point. It is in the air a bit, but safe
faster! Lee goes up to 144.2 kph, and there's a hint of swing into Gayle's pads. Played away to the offside
on a length, on leg stump at 139.6 kph, Gayle can't work it away to the legside
and it ends in fitting fashion. Another play and a miss outside off, KKR have prevailed easily, by 39 runs.
nice short ball again, angling into Lee who guided it down to third man. One ball to go.
good yorker again, outside off, Lee inside edges it and takes off, Saha misses the stumps that would have got Lee and delayed the finish by a bit.
yorker wide of off stump, can't get it away and they run a cheeky single, straight to Saha
fulltoss on leg stump, Lee tries to pull and can't get past mid on
bouncer, Lee is late on it, and gets a top-edge down to fine leg. KXIP have got more mis-hits to the boundary than proper shots tonight.
finishes off this time, with a length slower ball that Lee bunts down to long on
Bond lets out a roar as he puts a lot of effort into his last ball, to fellow tear-away Lee, but gets carried away a bit and it is a wide for height

caught Bond, bowled Bond! Another fast bouncer, Irfan is so late on the pull it pops up tamely for Bond to take it on his follow through. The old fat lady must be getting bored waiting for this to end.
fast and short again, Goel is late on the pull, and it goes back towards Bond who half-fields
full-pace bouncer this time, 145 kph, and Goel again can't get it down to third man
nice show bouncer, at 125 kph, Goel can't connect as he tries to run it down to third man.
finally! Goel's had enough of it all, picks the length ball and swings high over midwicket
full this time, at pull Angelo-pace, but Goel can only get it straight to long on
monotonous. Mathews again delivers on a length at 116 kph, the pull trickles down to midwicket
again, length ball, slow outside off and no KXIP batsman has got timing consistently today
another slow bouncer, 119 kph, pulled away to deep square leg
slower ball, angling across and guided away towards third man
another slow bouncer, from Mathews, Pathan waits and plays the pull, but can't time it as it runs down to square leg
this time, beaten by the sheer lack of pace! Nicely done by Bond, on a length at 117 kph, Goel's into the shot by the time the ball goes past him, misses leg stump through to the keeper
tries again, and is beaten a little more comprehensively. Can't connect with the attempted pull this time
only Karan Goel will now how he managed to play the pull shot and get it over the keeper's head for four. Maybe he was beaten by the sheer pace - 146.9kph
bangs it in short, Pathan is waiting, he rocks back and pulls to deep midwicket
shot! 142.9 kph, but it was on a length and wide outside off, Irfan freed his arms and played a delightful extra-cover drive
full and swinging on leg and middle, Irfan gets a thickish inside edge down to square leg
slow bouncer, 113.9kph, wide of off stump, and Irfan pulls it away
slightly wider this time, Goel stays back and opens the face to run it down to third man. KKR are keeping it tight.
full length on off stump, gets forward and drives but can't elude mid off.
short of a length on off stump, stays back and chops it away to point
good bouncer, hurried onto Irfan who went for the pull and got the top edge down to third man
majestic from Irfan! Over-pitched by Mathews on off stump, Pathan saw it got  under it and deposited over the straight boundary
shortens the length marginally, on leg stump, Irfan drives it down to wide long on
drifts on to the pads, worked away towards midwicket
107 kph, on Irfan's middle stump, gets forward and drives to long off
full on off stump, gets forward and drives down to cover

Sangakkara's gone in clumsy fashion and KXIP are going down in the same way here. Fired straight again, Sanga goes for a reverse sweep, misses and over-balances, Saha collects the ball, and Sanga takes a tumble as the bails are whipped off. Sanga ended up on the ground, and walked away before the third umpire made a decision
fired in on Irfan's pads, flicked away to midwicket
Sanga has timed one at long last. On a length, he got his front foot out of the way and drilled it straight enough to beat long on.
short and slow bouncer, and pulled down by Irfan, square of the wicket

Mathews has yorked Mahela! The batsman was looking to get some momentum going, by walking over to the offside, Mathews got a good sight of leg stump, aimed and hit it. Poor innings from Mahela today, got no timing
Sanga this time, tries to loft but can only drive on the bounce to long on
lofted well, but can't elude long off.

great work from Saha behind the stumps. Wridhiman redeems himself for an earlier gaffe. Sanga comes down and looks to go over midwicket, gets a thick inside edge that was running towards fine leg, Saha did well to regroup and dive full length to stop it. Nearly got a run out too, but missed the stumps.
fired in at 111.7 kph, Mahela can't get it past Hussey. This chase is going nowhere.
yorked outside the leg stump, Sanga heaves it down to long on
comes out and drives it down to long off this time
Sanga looks to go inside out, and can barely get it over the infield, Dinda concedes two
on the off stump, Mahela gets forward and works it away to midwicket off the pads
fired in, sliding down the leg and Sanga can't capitalise. Gets it down behind square leg where the fielder tidies up well
a complete and utter lack of timing for Sanga, who looks to loft the slower ball over long off, and can only get it over mid off
full on off stump, driven towards the offside, Mathews fields on his follow through.
slow bouncer, at 114 kph, Mahela pulls it to fine leg where Bond cleans up
slower ball, Sanga waits and drives it straight to long off
length ball, on off stump, Sanga can't time it past his Sri Lankan team-mate
length ball from Mathews, angling away from the left-hander, play and a miss
and again, Sanga's picking the singles well to midwicket. Punjab need more.
full on Mahela's pads and worked away well to midwicket
down the track, and flicked away to deep midwicket this time
nice little sweep and well fielded by Gayle at short fine leg, keeps it down to one
Sanga jumps out and takes it on the bounce and flicks to wide long on
length ball on off stump, worked away to midwicket
short again, and just outside Sanga's off stump, he stays back and opens the face to run it down to deep third man
length ball sliding on to Mahela's pads, worked away nicely behind square

nice bouncer and very nearly gets Mahela! It was well-directed and caught Mahela by surprise with that extra bit of pace, the pull ballooned to square leg where Bond dived forward, but could not get there. It ran away for four.
same ball, same shot, better fielding. Dinda misses the direct hit, though Sanga would have probably been in.
outside off this time, Sanga drives straight to Dinda at mid off, and he again fumbles to concede two.
short of a length on Sanga's leg stump, he quietly knocks it to the covers
ooh, Mahela looked to work it away from middle stump, and possibly got an inside edge on to his pads
better length, draws Mahels forward for the defence
short outside off, Mahela rocks back and cuts it away for two
flighted on off and middle, Sanga gets forward and drives to deep midwicket
slides down the leg at 95 kph and Sanga slaps it away very fine, past short fine leg for four.
full on Sanga's off stump, gets forward and plays back to the bowler

brilliant shot and even better fielding! On a length outside off, Mahela gets forward and caresses it all along the ground through the covers. Tiwary runs a mile and puts in a dive to stop it inches in front of the ropes
length ball on off stump, Mahela gets forward and defends. It is Sri Lanka v Kolkata now!
short of a length outside off, Mahela cuts away nicely to third man, this time Mathews fumbles and he's back for two.

and he goes this time! Agarkar has picked his second wicket, by following Bisla and keeping it on middle and leg. Bisla was down the track and looked to go straight, but did not get it straight enough. Hussey from mid off ran to his right and took a good low tumbling catch
short of a length, angling into Bisla, who stayed back and pulled despite being no position, the ball went high and landed in empty space between three legside fielders
good bouncer on off stump from Agarkar, Bisla lets it go
short ball, Sanga latches on and pulls it behind square leg, where Dinda makes a meal of the save.
Bisla ran all the way to mid-pitch and back, and just made it in time before Gayle could collect  Bisla's throw. Sanga had missed the ball and it ran to the offside off his pads
low fulltoss on offstump, played straight to Ganguly at  midwicket
short this time, Bisla makes his room and goes over the off side field
Missed stumping chance Bisla was well down the ground, and it was well down the leg side, Saha had enough time to get the bails off, but he had not collected
short of a length on off stump, he comes down the ground and taps it down
short of a length outside off, Sanga stays back and pats it to point. Yet again, Agarkar finds a way to go for a couple of big hits, but come back and take a wicket.

great catch!!! Yuvi looks to go downtown again, skies the loft over midwicket and it goes real high, the floodlights are really low here, there is a chance the ball went temporarily out of sight, but when it came back down, Manoj Tiwary had run from square leg to midwicket, dived to his right and plucked the swirler!
shot of the day! Length ball, agarkar has no movement going, Yuvi goes through with the straight drive, shows him the high elbow and it is six!
marginally short of a length, Yuvi says kthanxbai, rocks back and whacks it over midwicket
good start from Agarkar, pitched marginally outside leg and thudded into Yuvi's pads.
short of a length on Yuvi's pads again and he taps it to the leg side
full on his pads and Bisla drills it down to wide long on
very wide down the lg, looks to play a super-cheeky lap and still can't reach it
full ball on leg stump, driven back to the bowler
fired in at 101.4 kph, short of a length on Yuvi's pads. He quietly played it down to short fine leg
cleverly played, slaps the short ball just over the head of Ganguly at mid off, he stops it before it reaches the boundary.
full on Yuvraj's leg stump, gets forward and flicks to midwicket
short and wide, Bisla is roaming all over the crease and cuts straight to short third man
whacked by Bisla, just over the head of mid on. It was a length ball on leg stump, hit nicely, and Agarkar could not reach with his jump.
walks down the track, Dinda bowls it short of a length, Yuvraj looks to muscle it through the legside, but gets a thick inside edge for one, behind square
and he uncorks the pull shot! Picked the short ball early, stayed back and whacked it over the infield. Through to midwicket for four. Yuvi's getting his timing going.
fractionally straighter, Yuvi stays back and check-drives straight to point
that's timed nicely! Dinda gives him just enough room outside off to rick back and cut it behind point. Bond at third man slides over it
whoa, some more dangerous running, Yuvi tips straight to mid off and takes off, the under arm throw misses and he's in.
on Yuvi's off stump, he guides it to point
ooh, direct hit might have had him. Moves outside leg, but Bond follows him again at great pace, he gets it away off the back foot straight to mid on and runs a tight one.
145.8 kph, length ball, Bisla's eyes light up as he looks to heave over midwicket and very nearly holes out to the man in the circle on the leg side.
good bouncer, Bisla gets under it and sees it go through
145.6 kph, on a length angling across Yuvraj, who gets his bat down and gets a thickish edge down to third man
tests the umpire with a similar ball, he lets him go this time
another wide, starts outside off and finishes where the keeper would have been if they were playing on the adjacent pitch. Almost.
nice slower ball, short of a length at 107 kph outside off. He stays back and looks to cut, but can't time it
swing'namiss again. Short of a length well wide, he gives it all but makes no contact
loses the radar somewhat, sprays it outside off for a wide
nicely bowled, outside off on a length and moving away a bit. Misses the expansive cover drive
fuller outside off, Bisla looks to drive and can't connect
short ball outside off, picked early and pulled well down the ground, dead straight for four! Umpire makes way and lets it fly.
Part 2: Two fast, two furious. 144 kph and Yuvi is again late on the cut. Bond is bristling here!
fast and furious outside off! Yuvi is late on the attempt to guide it through the offside
length ball, drifts on to pads and he works it away to midwicket for one.
short ball, pegs Bisla back and lets him know who is boss. Bisla defends off the back foot.
and he's nailed him second ball! Short of a length at 139 kph, jags into Bopara, he was late on the shot, defeated his attempt to flick and thuds into his pads on the hop. Gone!
short of a length outside off, he lets it go to the keeper. 140+kph there.
